evidence: CVE.org record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-8239 is state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn). CNA ConcreteCMS titles it as IDOR in '/ccm/frontend/conversations/get_rating', CWE-862, affected git versions 5.0 through 9.5.0, CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N score 6.3.

GitHub advisory GHSA-2xp7-rpvc-pjwc is type=reviewed with no withdrawn_at, first_patched_version 9.5.1, and the same endpoint/existence+rating disclosure. Vendor 9.5.1 notes at https://documentation.concretecms.org/9-x/developers/introduction/version-history/951-release-notes list CVE-2026-8239 as fixed with that same get_rating IDOR.

At tag 9.5.0 (c747e425266ac50c12b5f2f74fa895ecec5cd777), POST /ccm/frontend/conversations/get_rating is routed to GetRating::view. getMessageID reads request field cnvMessageID; getMessage calls Message::getByID($messageID) (SQL `select * from ConversationMessages where cnvMessageID = ?` with no conversation filter) and throws only if the row is missing. The view then echoes getConversationMessageTotalRatingScore(). FrontendController::getBlockConversation() is unused on this path before the fix, so the loaded message is never bound to the current block conversation.

git log --diff-filter=A -- '*get_rating*' first-adds web/concrete/tools/conversations/get_rating.php in 50a7913e82c5fc28c910b276e5aa1cfb2433fd71. That commit object has a single parent and message 'getting ajax updates on message ratings to work'.

The added nine-line tool reads $_POST['cnvMessageID'], loads ConversationMessage::getByID, and echoes a rating with no conversation-ownership check (blob c25f95563c918f283c73163cff9ea5b22bed6b70). Later 6d0ec14cdb137c57d3a541e9c4dcfd914fd964ab only switches the echo to getConversationMessageTotalRatingScore(); 2ff8333f1268e0ba88659ab277b137651d14b399 moves the same lookup into the named frontend route; 8e62e38a47809f8a199fb934cc40b7d0a71827e7 only changes the parent class to FrontendController. None of those is a first-write of the missing-authorization mechanism.
